name: E.W. Graham
text: Finder of purported mammoth, partner of J.H. Startsman

name: Madison Grant
text: Secretary, NY Zoological Society. Goes to Alaska with LSQ 1907, assists up to Nome. Also President of the Taylor Creek Ditch Company, whose VP/Gen Manager is Andrew J. Stone

name: W.D. Matthew
text: Curator (?) in dept. of VP, AMNH. Reports on Startsman letters, recommends LSQ for job.

name: Edmond S. Meany
text: University of Washington professor, go-between for A-Y-P people and AMNH

name: J.P. Morgan Jr.
text: Paid for half of both 1907 and 1908 expeditions.

name: Percy Pyne
text: Paid for half of both 1907 and 1908 expeditions.

name: L.S. Quackenbush
text: Collector for the AMNH. Columbia Graduate (CA 262, 1906-1912, Box 92)

name: Henry E. Reed
text: Director of exploitation for 1909 Alaska-Yukon-Pacific Exposition

name: J.H. Startsman
text: Finder of purported mammoth, partner of E.W. Graham

name: Andrew J. Stone
text: Colleague of Madison Grant; asked, but refuses, to deal with the mammoth 1907
